messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we're seeing repeated micro-feedback from 3 new onboards about billing visibility + a per-route toggle that's confusing. Renewal flags on two accounts. Want a lightweight capture flow so we can funnel straight into product triage.
 tara_onboarding: +1. We need something zero-friction for CSMs and enablement — a short template and a Slack shortcut would be ideal. What fields do you want captured?
 jon_product: Agree that a tiny form is best. Can we include: customer, account age, impact summary, freq (how often seen), repro steps, screenshot/attachment, and suggested priority? I'll add a triage label if we can send into our tracker.
 liam_eng: For eng triage, also helpful to know: sample request ids, region, model/route name. If we can get a link to a replay or console logs that's ideal. I can wire a webhook to create a ticket from a Slack payload.
 maria_cs: Short template suggestion pasted below — keep it to a single Slack modal view. Feel free to tweak:
 ```
 Problem: one-sentence summary
 Customer: org name + contact
 Account age: days since signup
 Impact: user-facing symptom + business impact
 Frequency: once / intermittent / every session
 Repro steps: numbered short steps
 Route/model: (if applicable)
 Attachments: screenshot/link
 Suggested severity: low/medium/high
 ```
 tara_onboarding: That looks perfect. I already have two items to capture from onboarding calls today — will submit them into the form once built. cc @maria_cs for account ids.
 jon_product: I'll create a "cs-onboard-urgent" tag in the product tracker and a triage slot tomorrow. If we get 3+ similar reports within a week, we bump to P1 investigation. :thumbsup:
 feedback_bot: New capture created: FB-2026-117 — "Billing toggle unclear" — submitted by tara_onboarding. Linked to tracker: https://tracker.internal/FB-2026-117
 liam_eng: I'll prototype the Slack shortcut + webhook today and point it at a staging issue flow. @maria_cs can you drop a test account id so I can verify repro metadata?
 maria_cs: Sent test account in DM. Thanks team — let's aim to have the shortcut live by EOD so enablement can use it in tomorrow's calls.
